communities.name: Rwanda Land & Property Law Forum
communities.description: Public legal discussion on Law N° 027/2021 governing land in Rwanda, title transfers, parcel subdivision, expropriation in the public interest, and dispute prevention.
rules: Do not publish confidential land title UPI documents belonging to third parties without consent.
General legal education only; this does not constitute private solicitor representation.
Respectful civic discussion adhering to Rwandan legal standards.
communities.officialSource: Rwanda Land Management and Use Authority (RLMUA)

communities.name: Labor Rights & Workplace Fairness
communities.description: Guidance and peer discussions regarding employment contracts, termination, severance pay, occupational health, and maternity leave benefits under Rwandan Labor Law.
rules: Discussions must quote relevant articles of Law N° 66/2018 where applicable.
Defamation or naming specific ongoing confidential labor tribunal parties is strictly prohibited.

communities.name: Family, Matrimonial & Succession Law

laws.title: Law N° 66/2018 of 30/08/2018 Regulating Labor in Rwanda
laws.titleKinyarwanda: Itegeko N° 66/2018 ryo kuwa 30/08/2018 Rigenga Umurimo mu Rwanda
laws.sourceInstitution: Parliament of Rwanda / Ministry of Public Service and Labor (MIFOTRA)
laws.summaryEn: Governs employment relations, probation contracts, dismissal procedures, leave entitlements, minimum working conditions, and occupational safety in Rwanda.
laws.summaryRw: Rigenga imibanire y'umurimo, amasezerano yo kwinjizwa mu kazi, kwirukanwa, konji ziteganywa n'amategeko, n'umutekano w'abakozi mu Rwanda.

keyArticles.heading: Probationary Contract
keyArticles.description: Probation period cannot exceed six (6) months. Termination requires fifteen (15) days notice if probation exceeds 3 months, or 7 days if less.

keyArticles.heading: Dismissal on Grounds of Misconduct
keyArticles.description: Requires prior written warning and hearing. Gross misconduct justifies immediate dismissal under strict statutory criteria.

keyArticles.heading: Severance Allowance (Indemnité de licenciement)
keyArticles.description: Statutory calculation of severance pay based on years of continuous service when dismissal is not caused by gross negligence.

keyArticles.heading: Maternity Leave
keyArticles.description: Grants twelve (12) consecutive weeks of maternity leave with remuneration under RSSB maternity fund scheme.

laws.title: Law N° 027/2021 of 10/06/2021 Governing Land in Rwanda
laws.titleKinyarwanda: Itegeko N° 027/2021 ryo kuwa 10/06/2021 Rigenga Ubutaka mu Rwanda
laws.sourceInstitution: Rwanda Land Management and Use Authority (RLMUA)
laws.summaryEn: Comprehensive framework governing land tenure, leasehold rights, title registration (UPI), parcel subdivision, transfers, and expropriation in the public interest.
laws.summaryRw: Rigenga uburenganzira ku butaka, ihererekanya ry'ubutaka (UPI), igabana ry'ibibanza, no kwimura abantu ku mpamvu z'inyungu rusange.

keyArticles.heading: Land Registration & Title Deeds
keyArticles.description: All land in Rwanda must be registered and issued a Unique Parcel Identifier (UPI) through the national cadastre.

keyArticles.heading: Spousal Consent in Land Transactions
keyArticles.description: Any transfer, mortgage, or lease of matrimonial land requires notarized mutual consent of both spouses under applicable marital property regime.

keyArticles.heading: Subdivision of Agricultural Land
keyArticles.description: Prohibits subdivision of agricultural parcels below one (1) hectare to safeguard food security, unless specialized zoning permits.

laws.title: Law N° 007/2021 of 05/02/2021 Governing Companies in Rwanda
laws.titleKinyarwanda: Itegeko N° 007/2021 ryo kuwa 05/02/2021 Rigenga Amasosiyete y'Ubucuruzi
laws.summaryEn: Governs incorporation of domestic and foreign companies, digital registration via RDB portal, corporate governance, shareholder agreements, and dissolution.
laws.summaryRw: Rigenga ishyirwaho ry'amasosiyete y'ubucuruzi, iyandikwa ryayo binyuze muri RDB, inshingano z'abayobozi n'abanyamigabane.

keyArticles.heading: Online Company Incorporation
keyArticles.description: Establishes full legal validity of electronic certificates of incorporation issued by the Registrar General at RDB.

keyArticles.heading: Duties and Liabilities of Directors
keyArticles.description: Directors owe fiduciary duties of good faith, care, and avoidance of conflicts of interest to the company and stakeholders.

keyArticles.heading: Recognition of Foreign Corporate Documents (Apostille)
keyArticles.description: Documents legalized via the Apostille Convention are recognized without consular re-authentication.

laws.title: Law N° 058/2021 of 13/10/2021 Relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy
laws.titleKinyarwanda: Itegeko N° 058/2021 ryo kuwa 13/10/2021 Ryerekeye Kurengera Amakuru Bwite n'Ubuzima Bwite
laws.summaryEn: Establishes rights of data subjects, legal grounds for processing personal data, requirements for data protection officers, and cross-border data transfer rules.
laws.summaryRw: Rigena uburenganzira bw'umuturage ku makuru ye bwite, ibisabwa mu kubika amakuru, n'inshingano z'amasosiyete akora ku makuru.

keyArticles.heading: Principles of Data Processing
keyArticles.description: Personal data must be collected lawfully, transparently, for specified legitimate purposes, and kept accurate.

keyArticles.heading: Cross-Border Transfer Safeguards
keyArticles.description: Personal data may not be transferred outside Rwanda unless adequate protection or authorization from NCSA is proven.

laws.title: Law N° 68/2018 of 30/08/2018 Determining Offences and Penalties in General
laws.titleKinyarwanda: Itegeko N° 68/2018 ryo kuwa 30/08/2018 Riteganya Ibyaha n'Ibihano muri Rusange
laws.sourceInstitution: Ministry of Justice (MINIJUST) / Judiciary of Rwanda
laws.summaryEn: General penal code of Rwanda outlining criminal offences, penalties, circumstances of aggravation or mitigation, and rights of defense under due process.
laws.summaryRw: Itegeko ngenga rihana ibyaha muri rusange, rigena ibihano, n'uburenganzira bw'uregwa bwo kwiregura mu rukiko.

keyArticles.heading: Presumption of Innocence
keyArticles.description: Any person charged with a criminal offence is presumed innocent until proven guilty according to law in a public hearing.

keyArticles.heading: Fraud by Deception and Misrepresentation
keyArticles.description: Determines penal sanctions for financial fraud, forgery of public instruments, or unauthorized representation.
